title: CORAL: Adaptive Retrieval Loop for Culturally-Aligned Multilingual RAG
reasoning: The paper proposes a retrieval methodology for culturally-grounded queries. While the evaluation benchmarks (BLeND and CLIcK) include cultural and religious traditions such as ancestral rites (jesa), the paper's primary focus is on an agentic retrieval framework rather than a specific evaluation of faith, theology, or ethics.
